baseline.title: School resources
baseline.description: The HM understands why good school resources matter
baseline.objective: Improve the resources available in the school

tasks.name: Assess the current resources and infrastructure in the school
Detail the needs of the school
Identify resources the community can support with
List the requirements that need to be procured
Share the list with the CRP

transformed.title: School resources: needs prioritised with the SMC
transformed.description: The HM understands why good school resources matter
transformed.objective: Improve the resources available in the school Added: the priority order of needs is agreed by the SMC after a visible ballot, and published.

tasks.name: Assess the current resources and infrastructure in the school
Detail needs as a numbered shortlist of 5-8, each marked immediate or long-term, with one line of evidence
SMC priority meeting: approval ballot by SMC members and teachers, tally shown on chart paper, SMC agrees the priority order

x_transform.guardrail: Ballot informs agreement; women members vote and speak first

tasks.name: Identify resources the community, Gram Panchayat, block or donors can provide for the agreed priorities
List requirements to be procured; if the HM confirms a discretionary amount, SMC knapsack ballot over costed items

x_transform.guardrail: Skip the ballot without a confirmed amount

tasks.name: Share the list with the CRP
Post a one-page summary on the notice board and read it at the next PTM

pb_allocate.condition: Is a discretionary amount confirmed, how much, and from what source?
